The North Carolina public records are accessed through a unique identifier that is not related to either the NPI or the Medicaid CCN. There are a lot of facilities on the list that aren't ICF's -- they include group homes and other facilities, not just ICF's.

## Scrape NC public records links

Start here: <https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/searchpopup.asp> and just hit "Search" . There's no way to limit it to just ICF's.

```{r}
library(httr2)
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)


response <- request("https://info.ncdhhs.gov/dhsr/mhlcs/sods/results.asp") |>
  req_method("POST") |>
  req_body_form(
    bUnsavedChanges = "False",
    cmbCounty = "ALL",
    txtcity = "",
    txtfacname = ""
  ) |>
  req_perform()


html <- response |>
  resp_body_html()

county_sections <- html |>
  html_elements("div.section")


parse_county <- function ( section ) {
    county <- section |>  html_element("h3") |> html_text2()
    table <- section |>  html_element("table.dataTable")
    facilities <- table |> html_table()
    links <- table |>  html_elements("a") |> html_attr("href")

    facilities |> 
        mutate ( county = county,
                 linkid = links |> str_extract("\\d+$"), 
                 site_zip = as.character(`Zip Code`) 
        ) |> 
    janitor::clean_names()

}

all_counties <- map ( county_sections, \(c) parse_county (c)) |> list_rbind()

saveRDS(all_counties, "nc_pub_records_links.RDS")



```

This is a list of all of the facilities, not just ICF's . We need to match this back to the ICF list. We don't think any have closed in recent years, so we don't have to worry about missing the ICFs.

## Match ICFs

```{r}


icf_nc  <- readxl::read_excel("icfmr.xlsx") |> 
    janitor::clean_names() 
    

standardize_name <- function ( orig) {
    orig |> 
        str_to_lower() |> 
        str_replace_all ("[.,-/]", " ") |> 
        str_squish() |> 
        str_trim()

}

standardize_name ( "Ralph Scott Lifeservices,  inc.")



# there were some duplicates in the rows, but the only thing different are row numbers. Some are day programs, I think. 

std_icfs <- 
    icf_nc |> 
    distinct (  dba_name, site_zip, facility_address, license_number, ccn_number)   |> 
    mutate ( standard_name = standardize_name ( dba_name))

std_records <- 
    all_counties |> 
    mutate ( standard_name = standardize_name ( name))


exact_matches <- 
    std_icfs |> 
    inner_join ( std_records, join_by (standard_name == standard_name, site_zip == site_zip))  |> 
    group_by ( linkid , license_number, ccn_number) |>
    slice_tail ( n=1) |> 
    ungroup( ) 


```

From here, we can create another spreadsheet with the inspection page linked from the licenses. I'll come back to that later.
